scope: embedded gang-house healer, guard, key, emblem, and rubbish services
ADDDELAY live delay byte and delayed-command queue

native_findings.finding: The daily native cleanup removes persisted floor contents and room currency from inactive/repossessed houses, removes stray house deeds from room floors, returns one deed to the Realm Deed Office when a house is unowned, and suppresses that deed while the house is actively owned.
CLEARITEM 0 recursively clears all 17 visible plus 15 hidden native room item slots. It does not clear room currency; mcurou currency cleanup is a separate owner.

The retained database scripts provide exact house credentials, prices, healer spells, guard NPCs, generated keys/emblems, failure/message payload references, delays, and rubbish-room CLEARITEM 0 sequences. The initial string-form 'summon healer/guard' token is the player trigger; the later numeric SUMMON is the effect.

ADDDELAY adds to the live user byte at +0x6BB. Commands entered while delayed are queued rather than discarded; the native linked queue warns after nine existing queued nodes and refuses the next command after twelve existing nodes, yielding a 13-command retained maximum.

Type-11 gang shops require the matching Ability-184 controller item, own ten merchandise slots with a 20-unit per-slot cap, and retain per-slot price/currency. Duplicate item IDs may occupy a later slot after an earlier matching slot reaches 20. Native stock rejection covers GameLimit items, ability/ownership restrictions, equipped cursed-retained cases, and the item no-giveaway flag.

UNSTOCK ALL drains all ten slots onto the room floor and clears slot state. Single UNSTOCK selects a matching slot using the native lowest-quantity search and returns exactly one item to the character.
The native type-11 MARKUP command requires the Ability-184 controller and clamps the stored WORD markup to 0..1000 percent.
Shop type 11 exits the generic SELL owner immediately with 'You may not sell items to a gang shop.' Player-managed gang shops therefore have no invented player-to-shop resale path.

runtime_corrections: Daily mcurou cleanup now mutates the live persisted room-item/currency owners and reconciles gang-house deeds in shop.124.
Decoded gang-house healer, guard, key, emblem, and rubbish service scripts execute from their exact textblock operations rather than generic shop guesses.
CLEARITEM 0 removes the complete persisted room item tree while leaving room currency to its separate native owner.
ADDDELAY uses an 8-bit live delay and queues commands with native warning/refusal thresholds; queued commands drain through the normal dispatcher as delay expires.
Type-11 gang shops use a dedicated persisted ten-slot owner for STOCK, UNSTOCK, MARKUP, LIST and BUY, and explicitly reject SELL.
STOCK removes exactly one owned item/stack unit rather than incorrectly requiring the item definition to be consumable.

parity.reason: The remaining organization-specific persistence and house-service owners are now directly native-backed, connected to live persisted runtime state, and covered by executable regression checks.

out_of_scope_remaining_assertions: global Btrieve/MKDE save coordination and durability remain under native.save-coordination
Worldgroup page/telegram/channel presentation and broader communication edges remain under communication assertions
generic non-gang shop/healer service gaps remain under their own economy/service assertions
